The time complexity of the function is O(N * log(H)), where N is the number of tuples and H is the height. This is because for each tuple, we perform a binary search over the x-coordinates, which takes O(log(H)) time, and we do this for all N tuples.

- The initialization of xy_dict takes O(N) time.

- The binary search for each tuple takes O(N * log(H)) time in the worst case.
